proposed_widenings.name: ActivationResource.unlimited_or_at_will
proposed_widenings.justification: Non-spell triggered reactions currently require a consumable resource and reset cadence, but this item is an at-will reaction that spends only the normal reaction quota.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you're hit by an attack roll made with a Ranged or Thrown weapon while wearing these gloves, you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage ...

proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.free_hand
proposed_widenings.justification: The reaction is only legal when the wearer has a free hand. Current equipment predicates model wearing/holding/armor/weapon states but not empty-hand state.
proposed_widenings.evidence: ... if you have a free hand.

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall because the current magic-item triggered-reaction surface cannot represent an at-will reaction honestly. Secondary omitted rider: catching the projectile/weapon on reduction to 0 would need further surface work.
